Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 자신은 통증을 느끼지 못하니 괜찮다며 훈련을 재개하길 원한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> is insisting she can't feel any pain, and wants to resume training.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は自分は痛みを感じないので大丈夫だと言い、トレーニングの再開を望んでいる。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说自己感觉不到疼痛所以没关系，希望继续训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說自己感覺不到疼痛所以沒關係，希望繼續訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> insiste sur le fait qu'elle ne ressent aucune douleur et souhaite reprendre l'entraînement.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> besteht darauf, dass sie keine Schmerzen spürt und das Training wieder aufnehmen möchte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> insiste en que no siente dolor y quiere reanudar el entrenamiento.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> insiste que não sente dor e quer retomar o treino.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ยืนยันว่าเธอไม่รู้สึกเจ็บปวดและต้องการฝึกต่อ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bersikeras bahwa dia tidak merasakan sakit dan ingin melanjutkan pelatihan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> khẳng định mình không cảm thấy đau và muốn tiếp tục huấn luyện.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> जोर दे रही है कि उसे कोई दर्द महसूस नहीं होता, इसलिए वह ठीक है और प्रशिक्षण फिर से शुरू करना चाहती है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: No, we'll train again after you recover.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: いや、トレーニングは回復してからにしよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Non, nous nous entraînerons à nouveau après que tu te sois remise.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Nein, wir trainieren wieder, nachdem du dich erholt hast.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No, entrenaremos de nuevo después de que te recuperes.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Não, vamos treinar depois que você se recuperar.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่ค่ะ เราจะฝึกกันอีกครั้งหลังจากที่คุณฟื้นตัวแล้ว
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Tidak, kita akan berlatih lagi setelah kamu pulih.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không, chúng ta hãy huấn luyện sau khi cô hồi phục.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: नहीं, हम तुम्हारे ठीक होने के बाद फिर से प्रशिक्षण करेंगे।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: All right, let's give it our all!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Très bien, donnons tout ce que nous avons !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Tudo bem, vamos dar o nosso melhor!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ตกลงค่ะ มาพยายามให้เต็มที่กันเถอะ!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Baiklah, ayo kita berikan yang terbaik!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được rồi, hãy cố gắng hết sức nào!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है, चलो अपना पूरा जोर लगाते हैं!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Se entregó una poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบยาเพิ่มพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa một Bình Thuốc Hoạt Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar de entrenar y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar de treinar e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menghentikan pelatihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschlossen hatte, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y logró resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>พยายามอีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่น่าพอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber wieder.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>พยายามอีกครั้งแต่ก็ล้มเหลวอีกครั้ง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại nhưng thất bại một lần nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> était ravi de recevoir la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดีใจที่ได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hơn sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> औषधि मिलने के बाद खुश हो गई।
